items.title: The Yorkshire Wildlife Park tiger
items.summary: A man died after climbing into the tiger enclosure at Yorkshire Wildlife Park in Doncaster on Oct 10, and footage of Altai, a five-year-old Amur tiger, standing over him spread everywhere. The park's statement that Altai would not be put down got 199K likes on Pop Base's post, and X split over whether rangers should have shot him. On Oct 13 the man was named as William Chapman, 23, who had posted a video from inside the enclosure moments before; his family said he had a significant mental illness. The same day Trump posted the attack video on Truth Social with "Don't ever mess with nature!"

🚨 NEW: The man mauled by a tiger after entering its enclosure at Yorkshire Wildlife Park has been named as William Chapman

He posted a video of himself inside the enclosure just moments before the attack
